title: AWS MWAA issues to run DBT
answer:
It seems your installation path is slightly different. You are trying to access dbt in /usr/local/airflow/.local/bin/dbt, which means the Python environment would be /usr/local/airflow/.local.

Yet, your airflow runs from /usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/airflow, meaning the Python environment would be installed in /usr/local/ instead.

Try to change the bash command to:

/usr/local/bin/dbt --version
